name: yappr
description: Realtime speech recognition via a local yappr instance. Streams microphone PCM to yappr's loopback websocket and returns finished, punctuated utterances. yappr's own settings window fills these in when you set the plugin up from there.

host.description: Host yappr listens on. Always 127.0.0.1 unless you have tunnelled it: yappr binds loopback and has no setting that changes that. Blank this field to declare yappr unavailable and let OpenClaw pick another transcription provider.

port.description: Port yappr listens on. Must match [realtime] port in yappr's own settings window; yappr's AI pane writes both sides at once when you press Set up.

token.description: Shared token, only if [realtime] token is set in yappr. Sent as an Authorization bearer header and as a token query parameter. SecretRef values cannot be resolved by this plugin; use the YAPPR_REALTIME_TOKEN environment variable instead.

sampleRate.description: Sample rate of the audio OpenClaw streams. 16000 for browser and native dictation, 8000 for a Twilio media stream. yappr resamples anything else to 16 kHz.

encoding.description: Audio encoding. linear16 (PCM s16le) for dictation, mulaw for G.711 telephony. Anything else is refused rather than guessed.

url.description: Full websocket URL, overriding host and port. Only needed for a tunnelled or non-default endpoint: ws, wss, http and https are accepted, http/https are mapped to ws/wss, and any other scheme is an error.
